inlines.v: SC'ARLET, noun 1. A beautiful bright red color, brighter than crimson. 2. Cloth of a scarlet color. All her household are clothed with scarlet Proverbs 31:21. SC'ARLET, adjective of the color called scarlet; of a bright red color; as a scarlet cloth or thread; a scarlet lip.
